writeReplies.note: LinkedIn v1 post create, shareMediaCategory IMAGE (n8n 2.47.7 LinkedIn.node.js): POST /rest/images?action=initializeUpload {initializeUploadRequest: {owner}}, POST of the image bytes to the uploadUrl it returns, then POST /rest/posts {author, commentary, visibility, distribution, lifecycleState, content.media.id}; LinkedIn answers the post 201 with the share urn in x-restli-id and an empty body. Listed for a side that gets that far: the node has no text and no organization, so n8n 2.47.7 refuses the empty text before calling LinkedIn

n8nFails.why: the LinkedIn node has no text parameter (and postAs organization with no organization id): n8n 2.47.7 throws 'The Text field is empty' on its first item before any LinkedIn request

expect.offline: Topics, post text, image description and hashtags are model-driven (n8n's replies are recorded). The LinkedIn node has no text parameter and postAs organization with no organization id: n8n 2.47.7 throws 'The Text field is empty' on its first item before any LinkedIn request, so n8n's run ends failed at LinkedIn in every variant (the template's own configuration, not the bench). Merge (v3.2, append) hands LinkedIn two items, the image item and the hashtag item
